user.title: Set up Quizify
user.description: Quizify is a multiplayer trivia quiz game for Home Assistant. Players join from their phones via QR code; the TV shows the host view.

init.title: Quizify options
init.description: Optional Home Assistant integrations. Leave fields blank to skip — Quizify still works fully without them.

data_description.party_light_entities: Lights that should glow with the round phase (coral on question, sage on reveal, sun on finale).
data_description.tts_entity: TTS entity (e.g. tts.google_translate_say) used to announce milestones and round results.
data_description.media_player_entity: Speaker the TTS audio plays through. Required if TTS provider is set.
data_description.lobby_music_url: Optional URL of an audio file (e.g. /local/quizify-lobby.mp3, served from your config/www folder) looped on the media player above while waiting in the lobby. It stops when the game starts, so it never overlaps the TTS announcements that share the same speaker. Leave blank for no music. No audio file is included — supply your own.
data_description.avoid_recent_repeats: Skip questions that were shown in your recent sessions so replays feel fresh. Questions shown in the last few hours are held back, but only while enough fresh questions remain to fill a game — a small pack still fills every round rather than running out. Turn off to keep the original never-shown-first ordering.
data_description.community_submit_url: Optional worker endpoint that turns an in-app community-pack submission into a GitHub issue for review. Leave blank to hide the submission feature entirely. The GitHub token lives in that worker, never in your browser or Home Assistant.
data_description.community_submit_secret: Optional shared secret sent to the worker as an X-Quizify-Secret header. Set this to match the worker's SHARED_SECRET to stop anyone with the URL from filing issues. Leave blank if the worker has no secret (the default).
data_description.sfx_correct_url: Optional URL to a short sound played when the crowd mostly got the answer right. Leave blank to use the bundled default (if installed).
data_description.sfx_wrong_url: Optional URL to a short sound played when the crowd mostly missed the answer. Leave blank to use the bundled default (if installed).
data_description.sfx_streak_url: Optional URL to a short sound played when a player hits an answer streak. Leave blank to use the bundled default (if installed).
data_description.sfx_winner_url: Optional URL to a short sound played when the winner is decided. Leave blank to use the bundled default (if installed). Plays on the TTS speaker and is skipped while an announcement is live.
data_description.house_events_enabled: Fire quizify_* events on the Home Assistant event bus at game milestones (round start, reveal, streaks, winner) so you can drive your own automations. Off by default.
data_description.finale_scene: Optional scene activated when the winner is decided, alongside the party-light victory sweep, so you can drive a whole-room celebration look. Leave blank for no scene.

reset_admin_session.name: Reset admin session
reset_admin_session.description: Wipe the persisted admin session token. Use this if you can't access the admin panel because the saved token is out of sync. The next admin connection will bootstrap a fresh token.
